scenarios.name: Bull
assumptions: Hyperscaler AI data center power interconnection demand accelerates, with direct aeroderivative and HA gas turbine bookings exceeding $12B annually
Power segment gas turbine production slots sold out through 2030, driving pricing realization up +15% and robust slot reservation fees
Electrification segment EBITDA margins expand past 17.5% propelled by HVDC transmission links and utility transformer operating leverage
Onshore wind operating margin reaches 9.0% while offshore wind legacy backlog is cleanly ring-fenced and remediated ahead of schedule
Valuation multiple expands to 46x FY2027 EPS on elite industrial technology compounder rerating

scenarios.name: Base
assumptions: FY2027 net revenue reaches $52.5B with consolidated operating margin expanding to ~15.5%
Power segment delivers steady 12-14% organic revenue growth with gas turbine slot reservations exceeding 125 GW
Electrification segment maintains >30% growth with high-margin grid solutions and substations flowing through smoothly
Onshore wind operates at mid-single-digit margins (~5%) while offshore wind drag moderates to -$200M per year
Valuation multiple stabilizes near 42x FY2027 EPS

scenarios.name: Bear
assumptions: Hyperscaler datacenter power capex experiences a temporary digestion pause as regulatory grid delays stall cluster permits
Persistent offshore wind blade warranty remediation liabilities and Vineyard Wind arbitration penalties generate sustained cash drag of -$600M+
Severe electrical steel and high-voltage transformer supply chain bottlenecks constrain Electrification revenue recognition
Peak-of-cycle industrial concerns trigger multiple derating toward 27x FY2027 EPS
